items.title: Bob Watts Interview, 1963-02-28
items.q: I want to leave and go try it in St. Angelo with Ike, you know, Benson... I had the job with him

ctx.x: You understand? Well, they never did get angry. We didn't have no hard feeling when I told them I want to leave and go try it in St. Angelo with Ike, you know, Benson, see? And they told me all about Ike, about what a gal he was, but I thought they was telling me a bunch of lies. But I had to acknowledge to them when I went to Hart that you told me the truth, and I wouldn't listen. And then, well, all right, Tommy, I had the job with him, see? He had an old blind trumpet player named Pearson, but he could blow a…
Yeah, Pearson come up there, you know he come out there and he'll go, you see?
